==About==

A {{i|Wild Tuber}} is found by chance while {{i|Dig}}ging {{i|Dirt}} producing biomes. If you have learned the [[Potato Growing]] Skill, you can Plant a Wild Tuber in a {{i|Tilled Field}} to grow {{i|Any Potato}}s. It only takes a single Wild Tuber to Plant a Tilled Field at '''ANY''' % [[Tilled Field#Upkeep|Upkeep]], which makes Wild Tubers useful for resetting a Tilled Field which has been damaged by a {{i|Crow}}.
